news.title: Oil Futures Settle Mixed as Iran Says Hormuz Route Agreed With Oman
news.summary: Oil futures end little changed in a choppy session as Iran says it has agreed with Oman on a shipping route through the Strait of Hormuz, but that safe passage will depend on third parties not obstructing the process, an apparent reference to the U.S.  "The deal to open the Strait of Hormuz just got closer to reality," Mizuho's Robert Yawger says in a note.  "Perhaps the biggest question is whether Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps are on board with the agreement," he adds, noting that IRGC breached the June agreement by shooting at ships in the strait.
